official_title: The Evolution of Invasive Home Mechanical Ventilation in Denmark
summary: The aim of this study is to describe national trends over the past 10 years in patients receiving invasive home mechanical ventilation (HMV) in Denmark. This includes indications for invasive HMV, diagnostic groups, and one-year mortality.
